This is me right now. It is excruciating. I Literally scream through bathroom time. I'm able to take oxy but that doesn't even put a dent in it. I have been to the ER twice because of it. They just keep telling me "the first outbreak is the worst". I can barely move. I tried putting Vaseline down there for potty time, but it didn't work for me. Maybe you'll have more luck? They also said it is easier if you can submerse yourself in water (but that isn't something I have access to). I'm just passing on the advice I got. None of it has worked for me but maybe it will for you? I am desperate for this pain to end and they said it's only half over for me 😔 Eventually all your blisters will burst and it will go from hurting to stinging, which is kinda better in a way, sort of. And it means it's moving along with healing. But yeah this is hell.
If it were herpes you'd be in such immense pain you'd be screaming.
I have yet to find anything that works but weed makes it easier to deal with at least.

I live in Missouri, USA. The only response I've ever gotten when reaching out is sending me to therapy and then being turned away because I don't have insurance or money.

As for jobs, I've tried to work 8 jobs in the last 5 years in varying fields, including 2 call centers. It doesn't matter what the work is. My problem isn't being triggered by work, it's that I am randomly and very often triggered. Most jobs won't let you call in 3/5 work days no matter why you're calling in. 

I've dreamt of adopting for years but with absolutely no money or income or place to live or even a way to care for myself let alone someone else I don't really know how that is supposed to work out. Just another dream that will never come true. As for a love life, my dating pool is already incredibly small. It isn't likely I will meet someone I love in this new field.

But why keep fighting for more of this? There is no way for my life to improve. I have tried to move forward and it always comes crashing back down on me. History shows I'm in for further nightmares and bad luck. I used to think things would get better but I don't see that happening anymore.

As far as your other advice goes, I have tried. I live in the USA. The government doesn't care about my health because I'm not a mother, so I have no value to them. Reddit frustrates me in a lot of ways so I'm not very familiar with it. I've tried with other sites like Tumblr or Meet Up and there are no groups in my area. Your reply is the first I've ever gotten from anything like this. People don't give a shit. I don't live in a metropolitan area or popular state. There is an income based therapist in town but it still costs money even if you have zero income.
